title: Fast and smart seats: what each does, and six choices for you

owner_note.text: One page now lays out job by seat (today against your picture), the gaps, a recommended split, model/effort per seat (start high, trim by latency and cost, keep fast on Haiku), and how to experiment safely. Biggest gaps: fast hears whole thoughts after 2.5 s quiet, smart never sees fast's lines unless tail mode is on, and "handled" has no definition. Section 6 lists your six choices.
